# Meraki is Love, LLC — Soulful Tech

> Meraki is Love is a full-stack AI product studio operating under the Soulful Tech brand. Founded and led by Adam McClarin (CISSP, Azure AI Engineer) with 20 years of experience, the studio builds production-grade software where AI capability and security posture are designed together rather than bolted on. Based in Friendswood, Texas, serving clients worldwide.

## About

Meraki is Love ("meraki" — to do something with soul, creativity, and love) is the company; Soulful Tech is the brand. Adam McClarin is the founder and principal engineer, holding the CISSP certification, a dual MS in Cybersecurity (UMGC), an MBA (Baruch), and the Azure AI Engineer credential. The studio pairs senior product engineering with a security-first mindset on every engagement.

## Products

- **VeloxSync** — performance intelligence that flags at-risk talent six weeks before resignation.
- **VeloxSync for Education** — AI-powered homeschool planning built for families, covering up to six children on one plan.
- **Canopy Guard** — automated web visibility and security audit engine scoring SEO, AEO, GEO, and security posture across 47 signals.
- **Meridian AI** — executive intelligence with MFA and RBAC, exporting PPTX, PDF, and HTML from one workflow.

## Packages

- **Review** — $500 to $1,500, five days. A CISSP-informed review of an existing site or AI stack, with ranked findings, a fix order, and MITRE ATT&CK mapping where the stack includes AI or a multi-tenant app. Details: https://merakislove.com/packages
- **Meraki BIP** — from $7,000, six weeks. A scheduled lead engine, an assistant trained on the client's own documents, services, and pricing, distribution across two platforms from one dashboard, and a live activity view. Details: https://merakislove.com/packages
- **Custom build** — scoped after a call, two to eight weeks. Full-stack product, Presence-First site, or private AI inside a tool the client already runs. Details: https://merakislove.com/packages
- **Engagement types** — project (fixed scope), hourly ($85/hr for audits, advisory, and contained work), and retainer (after something is in production). The starting door is a project.
- **Presence-First Web Design** — immersive, experience-first websites for hospitality venues, wellness retreats, farms, event spaces, and boutique restaurants. Built in Next.js with GSAP scroll animation and a full-screen enter gate. Three tiers: Essential Presence ($4,500, 2 weeks), Signature Site ($7,500, 4 weeks), and Full Experience ($12,000 and up, 6 to 8 weeks). Details: https://merakislove.com/packages/presence-first-web-design
